test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In December 2024, which nationwide movement was launched to promote cycling as a sustainable and inclusive fitness activity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fit India Sundays on Cycle**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fit India Sundays on Cycle** was launched in **December 2024** as part of the **Fit India Movement**, an initiative by the **Government of India** to promote healthy living and fitness among citizens.
 
• The primary aim of this campaign was to encourage **cycling** as a **sustainable mode of transportation** and a way to promote **physical fitness**.
 
• Cycling is widely recognized as an **eco-friendly** and **cost-effective** activity that contributes to **reducing carbon emissions** and improving **public health**.
 
• **Fit India Sundays on Cycle** encouraged communities to dedicate their **Sundays** to cycling activities, fostering a culture of fitness and environmental sustainability.
 
• The initiative also emphasized inclusivity, allowing citizens of **all age groups** and backgrounds to participate in cycling events and activities.
 
• This program was supported by various **local governments**, **cycling clubs**, and **non-profit organizations**, ensuring its widespread reach and accessibility.
 
• The campaign aligns with the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, particularly those related to **climate action**, **health and well-being**, and **sustainable cities and communities**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Cycle for Bharat Campaign**__

 __
 
• This campaign title suggests a movement to promote cycling across **India**, but it is not the correct answer to the December 2024 initiative.
 
• While similar in its aim to encourage cycling, it does not have the specific focus on **Sundays** or inclusivity as emphasized by **Fit India Sundays on Cycle**.
 
 
 
• **Ride for Health India**__
 __
 
• This option highlights a campaign promoting cycling for **health benefits**, but it is not associated with the **Fit India Movement** or the December 2024 initiative.
 
• Such campaigns generally focus on individual fitness rather than community-wide initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Fit India Pedal Mission**__
 
 
• Although the name aligns with the **Fit India Movement**, this is not the correct initiative launched in December 2024.
 
• It might represent a specific campaign for cycling under the larger Fit India umbrella, but lacks the focus on **Sundays** or sustainable practices.
